statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let K (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), E ((k : ℝ) * b); ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : ℝ), 0 < W → W ≤ 1 / 2 → ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 / (2 * W) ≤ (intervalIntegral (fun b => (K N b)^2 * E (-(N : ℝ) * b)) (-W) W MeasureTheory.volume).re

plain_statement.en: For 0 < W ≤ 1/2, the real part of the twisted square-kernel integral on [−W,W] is at least N+1 − 1/(2W).
plain_statement.zh: 若 0 < W ≤ 1/2，则扭转后的核平方在 [−W,W] 上的积分实部至少为 N+1 − 1/(2W)。

brief.en: Reflection of the frequencies identifies the twisted square with the squared norm. Its period mass is N+1. On each omitted tail use the geometric sum and the sine chord bound.
brief.zh: 反射频率将扭转平方化为模平方，其完整周期积分为 N+1。在两段被截去的区间上，以几何级数公式及正弦弦长不等式估计尾项。
